The photo club looked quieter than usual that evening. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Sam believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. In fact, the kids watched Kong, the giant ape movie, twice.

Anna and Sam are preparing a report about the photo club. Sam wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Sam often share different ideas about the photo club. For example, the violin is a difficult instrument.

Sam will take part in a football match in December. At first, Sam found it difficult to keep the habit. The chess corner has become an important part of daily life. Also, late studio sessions ran past midnight.

On Sunday evenings, Sam reviews the notes from class. Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, the livestream replay clipped her speech.
Sam prefers rainy weather when running in the supermarket. Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
